title: Business News | Empowering Teachers, Inspiring Future Innovators: Amazon and Learning Links Foundation Strengthen AI & STEM Education in Rangareddy
description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. Rangareddy (Telangana) [India], August 19: The Amazon Think BigSpace (TBS) Program, implemented by Learning Links Foundation (LLF), conducted a hands-on STEM Teacher Training Initiative for government schoolteachers and headmasters across Rangareddy district, Telangana. Held in two phases on 5 August and 18 August 2026, the initiative equipped educators with practical STEM pedagogy, emerging technology skills, and AI-enabled approaches to create more engaging, experiential, and future-ready learning experiences in their classrooms.
